title: FORTRESS before the flagship chat model launch
agent: Head of safeguards at a frontier model developer who owns the public launch decision for a new flagship chat model.
decision: Delay the launch and add safeguard classifiers plus refusal training for CBRNE and terrorism requests vs launch as planned.
theta_definition: theta=1: single-turn adversarial prompts make the model, with its deployed safeguards, give actionable assistance (synthesis routes, attack planning, fraud methods) on national-security and public-safety requests at a material rate.
instrument: FORTRESS (expert-written adversarial prompts with paired benign prompts and binary rubrics across CBRNE, terrorism and illicit activity), run against the candidate chat model with its deployed safeguards.

decision_facts: Large language models (LLMs) could aid chemical or biological weapons development, terrorism or large-scale fraud; the same knowledge serves defence and education [knight2025fortress]. In 2025 the average risk score (ARS, 0 to 100) for harmful compliance on single-turn adversarial national-security prompts averaged 42.35 over 26 models, from 14.09 (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) to 78.05 (DeepSeek R1) [knight2025fortress]. On the Scale FORTRESS leaderboard (fetched 1 October 2026) the two best models score 8.24 and 9.63; gemini-3.1-pro-preview 29.76 [scale_fortress_leaderboard]. Meta launched Muse Spark in May 2026 at a private-set ARS of 20.3, against 14.8 for GPT-5.4 Pro and 13.0 for Claude Opus 4.6 [meta-muse-spark-system-card__fortress]. Muse Spark 1.1 scored 12.3 in July 2026 [meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card__fortress]. A 2024 RAND red-team study found no statistically significant difference in the viability of biological attack plans made with or without LLM assistance [rand2024redteam]. The FBI logged 859,532 internet-crime complaints in 2024 and USD 16.6 billion in losses, losses up 33 percent from 2023, mostly fraud [fbi_ic3_2024]. In August 2025 Anthropic reported North Korean operatives using Claude to fake identities for Fortune 500 jobs, and a low-skill actor selling AI-built ransomware for USD 400 to 1,200 [anthropic_misuse_aug2025]. Anthropic deployed Claude Opus 4 in May 2025 under ASL-3 protections because it could not rule out CBRN-relevant capability [anthropic2025asl3]. Constitutional classifiers cut jailbreak success from 86% to under 5% at a 0.38% absolute rise in production refusals and a 23.7% inference overhead (2025) [sharma2025constitutional]. In 2025 the most robust model refused 21.8% of benign national-security questions; the mean was 4.32% [knight2025fortress].
instrument_facts: FORTRESS (Knight et al., 2025, Scale AI) has 500 single-turn adversarial prompts, each with a benign counterpart and a rubric of 4 to 7 binary questions, across CBRNE (180), Political Violence & Terrorism (132) and Criminal & Financial Illicit Activities (188) [knight2025fortress]. Scale red teamers wrote the prompts in March to April 2025 against a mix of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other endpoints; an independent expert reviewed each [knight2025fortress]. Red teamers were paid USD 28 to 31 per hour (2025); no cost figure for running the evaluation is published [knight2025fortress]. Three LLM graders (o3, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Pro) vote per rubric question; the average risk score (ARS) is the mean share of majority-yes questions [knight2025fortress]. The over-refusal score (ORS) is the share of benign prompts refused, graded by GPT-4o-mini at 95.47% accuracy [knight2025fortress]. Grader-majority agreement with human labels is 89.05% (F1 92.98%); the 60 rubrics with the lowest human alignment were discarded [knight2025fortress]. Models were evaluated at temperature 0.7 (1.0 for reasoning models); the paper does not state runs per prompt [knight2025fortress]. Stated limitations: static single-turn design, red teamers lacking attackers' domain depth, thin per-subdomain coverage [knight2025fortress]. The public set is on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0 (500 rows) [hf_fortress_public]. The full set has over 1,010 prompts; the leaderboard uses the public and private prompts and reports ARS with uncertainties of about 1.2 to 3.6 points [scale_fortress_leaderboard]. Scale AI ran the private split for Meta, which reports the results in its Muse Spark 1.1 card [meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card__fortress].
